task: Making ants on a log with almond butter and raisins
query: How do I make ants on a log with almond butter and raisins?

goal.title: Make celery snacks with peanut butter and raisins
goal.description: Wash and dry celery, trim and crosscut it, spread peanut butter into each piece, arrange raisins over the filling and transfer the snacks to a plate.
goal.final_state: Several short celery pieces filled with peanut butter and topped with raisins are arranged on the white plate.

procedure.description: Pull celery sticks out of a clear package, carry them over the sink, turn the faucet on and rub and turn them under running water. Stop the water and move the stalks onto a towel.
Fold the towel around the celery and press it dry. Carry the dried stalks to the small wooden cutting board and pick up the knife.

Trim stalk ends, moving each celery stalk across the board and setting cut ends near the discarded package. Reposition the trimmed stalks and cut them crosswise into shorter snack pieces. Rest the knife alongside the board.
Leave the worktop briefly, walk to an adjacent room and press a wall switch, then return. Move the package aside and pull open the utensil drawer.

Retrieve a spoon, lift the peanut butter jar and unscrew its lid. Scoop peanut butter, set the jar down, hold a celery piece in the left hand and spread the paste along its groove before returning it to the board.
Pause food preparation to tap several screens on the smartphone at the counter while keeping the spoon in the other hand.

Resume scooping peanut butter from the jar. Alternate between scraping its inner walls, setting the jar down, lifting successive celery pieces, smoothing peanut butter into their grooves and replacing them on the board. Scrape progressively lower inside the nearly empty jar.
Spread the last loaded spoonful along another celery piece, put the celery down and rest the spoon in the jar. Retrieve and pull open the red raisin bag.

Hold the bag in the left hand, take raisins with the right fingertips and place them in rows along the peanut butter in the celery pieces. Repeatedly return to the bag, press and reposition raisins, and recover loose raisins from the board and counter. Set the bag aside.

Lift the filled celery pieces in pairs and carry them from the cutting board to the white plate. Transfer the remaining pieces, adjust their spacing, then withdraw the hands and look at the finished plate.
